info.title: stlLibrary API
info.description: The stlLibrary server's HTTP API. Every route except `/api/auth/status`, `/api/auth/setup`, `/api/auth/login` and this document needs a session: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or the `stl_session` cookie set at sign-in.

post.summary: Save a reviewed suggestion to a model.

get.summary: Whether the AI tagger can run, and with what.

post.summary: Sign in. After five failures a name is locked out for 15 minutes.
End this session.

put.summary: Change your own password. Ends all your sessions, this one included.

post.summary:
Create the first administrator and sign in. Only while no user exists, and
only from the server's own machine (not through a proxy).

get.summary: Whether setup is needed and who is signed in. Needs no session.
Every creator name with its model count.

post.summary: Rename, merge or delete a creator name across all models.

get.summary: A creator's profile (404 when there is none).

put.summary: Create or update a creator's profile; blank values are stored as null.

get.summary: The backups on the server, newest first.
Download a backup.
The downloadable components and whether each is installed.
The folders tracked for crawling (Update Crawled Folders).

post.summary: Track a folder for crawling (201), or 200 when it is already tracked.
Stop tracking a folder (its models stay).

get.summary:
Completion lists: `titles`, `creators`, `sources`, `dates`, `tags`,
`releases`, `sculptors`, `collections`, `subcollections`, `categories`, `scales`.
The subcollection names of one collection.

The event stream: [`ServerEvent`] JSON text frames (job progress and logs,
library changes). Authenticates like any route (the session cookie works
for browsers, which cannot set headers on a WebSocket).
List a folder on the server (editor role): subfolders and archives.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The folder to list; empty lists the starting points.

post.summary: Every value list and count the filter pane shows.

get.summary: The folders holding catalogued archives (forward slashes), sorted.

delete.summary: Remove one image and its thumbnail.

get.summary:
An image at full size: the original the thumbnail was made from, read from
the archive (or from the file beside it). 404 when it cannot be had (an
image added by hand, a moved archive): show the thumbnail instead.
An image's thumbnail: a redirect to its content address.
Queued, running and recently finished jobs, oldest first.

post.summary:
Queue a job. Jobs run one at a time, in order. Needs the editor role
(compacting the database and backups: admin).

get.summary: One job with its log.

delete.summary:
Cancel a job: a queued one at once, a running one at its next checkpoint
(what it finished so far stays). 409 when it has already finished.

get.summary: Every row of a lookup table by name (subcollections by collection, then name).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: tag, category, collection, subcollection or scale

post.summary:
Add a row. 409 when the name exists (within the collection, for a
subcollection) or the parent collection does not.
Merge two rows: models of `remove` get `keep`, then `remove` is deleted.

get.summary: What deleting a row would affect.

delete.summary: Delete a row. Models lose the value; a collection takes its subcollections.

patch.summary: Rename a row; 409 when the new name is taken.

post.summary:
Merge each missing record into the record found at its new location: the
metadata of the missing one moves there (Merge Moved).

Remove records from the library and prune lookups left unused (Remove
Selected / All Missing). The archive files are not touched.

get.summary: Your own settings: key → any JSON value.

put.summary: Store one of your settings (the body is its JSON value, at most 64 KB).

patch.summary:
Apply browser-table cell edits in one transaction, in order. Tags are
lowercased and de-duplicated; a subcollection belongs to its collection.

post.summary:
Remove models from the library (their images and thumbnails too). The
archive files are not touched.
The ids of the models matching the query, in display order.
Apply the mass editor's changes to the listed models in one transaction.

What a path pattern extracts from each model's archive path (the mass
editor's "Show parsed values"); nothing is saved.
Rows for `ids`, in that order; unknown ids are skipped.

get.summary: One model's display fields and its images.
Download a model's archive file.
A model as the editor shows it.

put.summary: Save the editor's form for one model.

get.summary:
The printable files the crawl stored for a model (empty unless the library
stores STL file lists), by name.

post.summary:
Add images to a model (multipart form, one file per part). Each becomes a
thumbnail (resized to the library's thumbnail size); the original is not kept.

get.summary:
Which archive members trigger each of the model's stored warnings (the
archive's catalog is read now).

post.summary: Search with an image (multipart, one file).

parameters.name: max_distance
parameters.description: dHash: most differing bits (0 = identical; default 10).

get.summary: The library settings.

put.summary:
Change the library settings (administrators). Takes every field; the
desktop app reads the same file.

post.summary: Where the archives would go (nothing is moved).

get.summary: How the models spread over one column's values, most frequent first.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Most frequent values to return (all when absent).

get.summary: Counts, sums and rankings for the Statistics view.
Name, version and library size.

post.summary: Merge tags into one (Tag editor → Merge).

get.summary: Tags no model uses.

delete.summary: Delete the tags no model uses.

get.summary: A thumbnail by content address.

parameters.name: digest
parameters.description: Hex digest from an image's `thumbnail` URL

get.summary: Every user, by name.

post.summary: Create a user.

delete.summary: Delete a user (not the last enabled administrator).

patch.summary:
Change a user's role, enabled state or password. The last enabled
administrator cannot be demoted or disabled.

post.summary: Thumbnail cells for the archives in a folder (and its subfolders), by path.
Thumbnail cells for models, in the order asked.

failed.description: File names that could not be read as images.

overwrite.description: Replace values already set (default: fill empty fields only). Tags are merged.

AiFieldValues.description: The metadata fields the tagger fills (`normalize_meta`).

AiStatus.description: What the AI tagger can use.

detail.description: Why it is not available, or where it comes from.

running.description: A started `llama-server` is running (always false with `url`).

AiSuggestion.description: What the model suggests for one model.

image_ids.description: The images sent (their thumbnails), in order.

setup_required.description:
No user exists yet: the first administrator must be created
(`POST /api/auth/setup`, from the server's own machine).

oneOf.description: The signed-in user, if the request carries a live session.

action.description:
`rename` (`name` → `to`), `merge` (`name` into `to`, keeping `to`'s
profile) or `delete` (clear `name` from its models).

Cell.description: One model as a thumbnail cell.

images.description: How many images the model has.

value.description: The cell text as typed; empty or null clears the field.

models.description: How many of the listed models exist (and were changed).

ComponentStatus.description: One component as the Maintenance page shows it.

detail.description: Where it is, or why it is in that state.

sizes.description: Download sizes per variant (`default` for components without variants).

state.description:
`installed`, `missing`, `external` (configured elsewhere, not managed
here) or `unavailable` (no download for this platform).

free_bytes.description: Free space where the data directory is.

nvidia_gpu.description: An NVIDIA driver is installed (the CUDA runtime is the better choice).

platform.description: `windows-x64`, `linux-x64`, or null when nothing can be downloaded here.

variants.description: The AI runtime's variants here; the first is the default.

ContentRow.description: Two archives sharing STL files (name and size).

pattern.description: The path pattern used when crawling it.

month.description: Absent (or null) for the whole year.

EditorSave.description: The editor's form. Empty strings clear; lookups are created by name.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

FilterSpecDto.description:
Include/exclude values per facet (`creator`, `tag`, `path`, `date`,
`sculptor`, …), has-value / no-value groups and an optional id list.
Lookup facets take ids, `date` takes `{year, month}`, the others text.

scoped.description: Whether the counts are scoped by a filter.

oneOf.description: The current filter; the counts of each section are scoped by the others.

FilterValueDto.description: A selected filter value: text, a lookup id, or a release date.

regex.description:
`find` is a regular expression (Rust fancy-regex); `replace` then takes
`\1`, `\g<name>`, `\n` as in Python.

ids.description: The models, in the order wanted (at most 500).

best.description: The best match: differing bits (`dhash`) or cosine similarity (`clip`).

thumbnail.description: Where the thumbnail is served; absent when the image has none.

shared_skipped.description: Distinct images left out as shared by too many models.

truncated.description: More pairs matched than are kept.

log.description: The job's log, oldest line first (at most the last 2,000 lines).

oneOf.description: What a duplicate finder found, once it is done (`pairs` or `groups`).

message.description: The outcome (a summary, or the error).

oneOf.description: Crawl a folder of archives.

force_rescan.description: Re-extract archives whose hash did not change.

pattern.description:
Folder path pattern (`{sculptor}/{release}/{title}`); default: the
pattern stored for this crawled folder.

oneOf.description:
Re-crawl crawled folders (all of them, or `folders`) with their stored
patterns, matching archives moved from one folder to another before
deleting the records of archives that are gone (Update Folders).

Delete every record, lookup and thumbnail of the library (Delete
Database; administrators). `confirm` must be `"DELETE"`.
Check that every archive is still on disk, unchanged in size.
Compute perceptual hashes from stored thumbnails (all, or only missing / outdated).
Keep at most `keep` images per model (the oldest).
`VACUUM` the database and truncate its write-ahead log.
Compute CLIP embeddings from stored thumbnails (all, or only images without one).

Find Duplicate Archives → STL files: archive pairs whose file lists
(name and size) overlap by at least `threshold` (0–1) of the larger list.
Find Duplicate Archives → Images: archive pairs with matching images.

max_models.description: Images found in more models than this (banners, logos) are left out.

oneOf.description:
Write `METADATA.7z` in every folder holding catalogued archives (needs
sidecars enabled in the library settings).
Delete `METADATA.7z` from every folder holding catalogued archives.

Tidy the `METADATA.7z` files under the crawled folders: rewrite those
listing archives that are gone, delete those whose archives are all gone,
and delete leftover `METADATA.7z.tmp` files.

Back up the database, thumbnails and settings to
`<data dir>/backups/stlLibrary_backup_<stamp>.7z` (administrators).

Download optional components into the data directory (administrators):
`ai_runtime`, `ai_model`, `clip_model`, `onnxruntime`, `pdfium`.
`variant` is the AI runtime's (`cpu`, or `cuda` on Windows).
Delete downloaded components (administrators).

Re-read the models' archives: metadata, presupports, warnings, scales,
hash (Rescan).

Replace the models' images with ones from their archives, at most
`max_thumbnails` each (default: the library setting).

Move the models' archives into a folder tree under `target_dir` built
from `pattern` (Sort Files). Needs *file sorting* in the settings.

Move the models' archive files to the trash folder (or delete them,
without one) and remove the records. Needs *allow file delete*.

Ask the AI tagger for one model's tags and metadata; nothing is saved
(save the reviewed result with `/api/ai/commit/{id}`).

ignore_meta.description: Leave the catalogued metadata out of the prompt.

max_tags.description: At most this many tags (0: no limit).

oneOf.description:
Tag every model with the AI tagger and save the results: empty fields
only, unless `overwrite`; tags are merged.

Records cataloguing the same archive more than once (same content hash,
else same file name and size).

For each record, another record with the same content whose archive is on
disk (Find Moved in DB); merge them with `/api/maintenance/merge-moved`.

Look under `folder` for the records' archives (by content hash) and point
the records at the archives found.

Re-read every archive's file list and fix one warning line:
`no_images` or `presupported`.
Find Duplicates (metadata): models with equal or similar values.

columns.description:
Column keys: title, creator, source, sculptor, collection,
subcollection, category, release, scale.

JobRequest.description:
What to run. Crawl settings not given here come from the library's
`settings.json`, as in the desktop app.

oneOf.description: Records of a maintenance list (Verify, duplicate entries, moved, found).

allOf.description: The AI tagger's suggestion for one model (`ai_suggest`).

oneOf.description: The AI tagger's suggestion for one model (`ai_suggest`).

JobResult.description: What a finder or maintenance job found (`JobDetail.result`).

entries.description: Folders first, then archives, each by name.

parent.description: Its parent, when the user may go there.

path.description: The listed folder (empty for the starting points).

truncated.description: More entries exist than were returned.

manual.description:
`source`, `creator`, `release_date`, `url`, `title` → template
(`{token}`s from the path pattern and file name), or null to clear.

overwrite.description: Path values replace existing ones (otherwise they fill empty fields).

pattern.description:
A path pattern (`{sculptor}/{release}/{title}`) parsed from each
model's archive path; its values are applied per model.

trim.description: Strip leading and trailing whitespace from the text fields.

remove.description: The row merged into it and deleted.

errors.description: Items whose records no longer exist.

MetadataGroup.description: Models with equal or similar values in one column.

client_path.description:
The archive's path as this client sees it, when it can open it there
(a client on the server's machine, or a `path_map` entry); otherwise
offer `/api/models/{id}/archive`.

search.description: Matched against title, creator, path and tags (case-insensitive).

oneOf.description: Display order; ties and no sort are ordered by id.

id.description: The missing record, whose metadata is kept.

path.description: The archive path of the record crawled at the new location.

fields.description:
What the pattern extracted (`title`, `sculptor_name`, `release_name`, …), in
pattern order; empty when the path does not match.

Profile.description: A creator's profile links; each may be null.

value.description: The value (a name, a year, …); null for "none".

RecordRow.description: One record of a maintenance list (`_result_row`).

match_path.description: Another record's path (duplicates, moved) or where the archive was found.

pruned.description: Lookup rows no model uses any more, deleted with them: `{table: rows}`.

Role.description: What a user may do. Ordered: each role includes the ones before it.

is_missing.description: The archive was not on disk when last checked.

capped.description: All of the closest images matched: more may exist (tighten the threshold).

outdated.description: dHash: stored hashes in an older format, not compared (run Recompute image hashes).

oneOf.description: A job was queued, started, progressed or finished.
One log line of a running job.
The library changed (`models`, `lookups`, `crawl`, …): reload what is shown.
Events were dropped for this client (it was too slow); reload everything.

ServerEvent.description: What WebSocket clients receive (`/api/events`), as JSON text frames.

token.description: For `Authorization: Bearer`; browsers can rely on the cookie instead.

Settings.description: The settings, with their effective values (defaults filled in).

ai_temperature.description: The AI tagger's sampling temperature (0 to 2; lower is more literal).

allow_file_delete.description: *Delete files* may remove archives from disk.

low_compression_threshold.description: Compression rate above which an archive counts as poorly compressed.

presupport_patterns.description: Regular expressions for presupported STL file names (the portable subset).

use_trash_folder.description: Deleted archives go to `trash_folder_path` (when set) instead of being deleted.

target_dir.description: The folder the tree is built in (a server folder).

hash.description: The file's content hash, when the crawl stored one.

target.description: The resulting tag's name (an existing tag, matched case-insensitively, or a new one).

password.description: A new password; ends the user's sessions.

error.description: Why the archive's files could not be listed.

members.description:
The members that trigger it now (empty for warnings raised by an
absence, or ones that no longer reproduce).
